# My New Skills

> Practice workbook publisher in Dunedin, New Zealand. Prints and posts workbooks for handwriting, mental arithmetic, sketching and touch typing. No course, no tutor, no assessment, no certificate.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mynewskills.com/): what the books are, how an order runs, questions answered
- [Handwriting books](https://mynewskills.com/handwriting-books.html): three books ruled to three heights
- [Number practice](https://mynewskills.com/number-practice.html): tables, mental methods, written methods
- [How a book is built](https://mynewskills.com/how-a-book-is-built.html): exercise order, ruling, paper, binding, proofing
- [Order a set of books](https://mynewskills.com/order-a-set.html): the order form

## Contact

Mailbox: post@mynewskills.com. Posts throughout New Zealand and to Australia.
